x-prompt.message: What scope should the library have?

items.label: Shared: General libs, used by multiple other apps
App Specific: Used only by an app

x-prompt.message: What type of library do you want to create?

items.label: feat: Features containing smart components and business logic
data-access: Responsible for communicating with APIs or databases
util: libraries that contain helper functions or reusable logic
generated:api: models, services and types generated by backend specs

name.x-prompt: What is the name of the library? For Example 'stammdaten'
name.errorMessage: The name can only contain letters and hyphens, and must not include 'app', 'lib', or reserved type names like 'util', 'data-access', 'feat', 'ui'.
